source: Independent Configurator 8.5.1.1529 imports and exports of single-standard-field RLS conditions; two stored conditions omitted by the native XML exporter are retained as unsupported witnesses.

	<setForNewObjects>false</setForNewObjects>
	<setForAttributesByDefault>false</setForAttributesByDefault>
	<independentRightsOfChildObjects>true</independentRightsOfChildObjects>

				<field>PredefinedDataName</field>
				<condition>WHERE FALSE</condition>
			</restrictionByCondition>
		</right>
	</object>
</Rights>
